**API 209 students only.** Not in API 209? Please don't book a slot here. Email me instead at rrodriguezramirez \[at\] g \[dot\] harvard \[dot\] edu.
:::

::: {.oh-intro}
Choose online or in person, then pick a **10-minute slot**. The times you see come straight from my calendar, so anything open is genuinely open. After you book, you will receive a calendar invite with the Zoom link or the room. Accept it and it lands on your calendar.
:::

```{=html}
<ul class="oh-meta">
  <li>10 minutes, one student per slot</li>
  <li>Bring your question, code, or problem set</li>
  <li>Cancel from the invite if plans change</li>
</ul>

<div class="oh-tabs" id="oh-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Office hours format" hidden></div>

<div class="oh-embed" id="oh-embed" hidden>
  <iframe id="oh-frame" title="Book an office hours slot" loading="lazy"></iframe>
</div>

<div class="oh-setup" id="oh-setup" hidden>
  The booking calendar is not connected yet.<br>
  Paste a Google Calendar appointment link into <code>SCHEDULES</code> in <code>office-hours/api-209/index.qmd</code>.
</div>

<p class="oh-fallback" id="oh-fallback" hidden>
  Calendar not loading? <a id="oh-link" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the booking page in a new tab</a>.
</p>

<script>
  // ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // One entry per Google Calendar appointment schedule.
  // Google Calendar → the schedule → Share → copy the booking page link.
  // Leave `url` empty to hide an option until its schedule exists.
  const SCHEDULES = [
    {
      id: "online",
      label: "Online",
      url: "https://calendar.google.com/calendar/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ2iK-ZkttOSsjk1kIOUaA2VbZPyQScB3Tl45_B6mzf7708VShD7iI-0HgoKR7CI7Nr0NagIrVhO",
      where: "On Zoom. The link is in the calendar invite you receive after booking."
    },
    {
      id: "in-person",
      label: "In person",
      url: "https://calendar.google.com/calendar/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ3sF473bpox4eaITxAhcP1do24PWNwAzs6Ca9z3zm56uFnNTpoTAdsdjIXniU0pJiO33CSZ1OZK",
      where: "In person on Fridays at the Winter Garden, Kennedy School. Details are in the calendar invite."
    }
  ];
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const tabs     = document.getElementById("oh-tabs");
    const embed    = document.getElementById("oh-embed");
    const setup    = document.getElementById("oh-setup");
    const fallback = document.getElementById("oh-fallback");
    const frame    = document.getElementById("oh-frame");
    const link     = document.getElementById("oh-link");

    const active = SCHEDULES.filter(s => s.url);
    if (!active.length) { setup.hidden = false; return; }

    // Google booking pages accept ?gv=true to render the embeddable view.
    const embedUrl = u => u.includes("gv=true") ? u : u + (u.includes("?") ? "&" : "?") + "gv=true";

    function select(s, pushHash) {
      frame.src = embedUrl(s.url);
      link.href = s.url;
      const where = document.getElementById("oh-where");
      if (where) where.textContent = s.where;
      tabs.querySelectorAll(".oh-tab").forEach(b =>
        b.setAttribute("aria-selected", b.dataset.id === s.id ? "true" : "false"));
      if (pushHash) history.replaceState(null, "", "#" + s.id);
    }

    if (active.length > 1) {
      active.forEach(s => {
        const b = document.createElement("button");
        b.className = "oh-tab";
        b.type = "button";
        b.role = "tab";
        b.dataset.id = s.id;
        b.innerHTML = s.label + (s.detail ? "<small>" + s.detail + "</small>" : "");
        b.addEventListener("click", () => select(s, true));
        tabs.appendChild(b);
      });
      tabs.hidden = false;
    }

    // Deep link: /office-hours/api-209/#in-person opens that option directly.
    const fromHash = active.find(s => "#" + s.id === location.hash);
    select(fromHash || active[0], false);

    embed.hidden = false;
    fallback.hidden = false;
  });
</script>

<div class="oh-notes">
  <div>
    <h3>Where</h3>
    <p id="oh-where">The location is in the calendar invite you receive after booking.</p>
  </div>
  <div>
    <h3>Nothing open?</h3>
    <p>Email me at rrodriguezramirez [at] g [dot] harvard [dot] edu and we will find a time.</p>
  </div>
  <div>
    <h3>Groups</h3>
    <p>Working on the same problem with a classmate? Book one slot and come together.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```
